meta.title: Subscription cancellations taking effect
meta.question: How many subscription cancellations took effect during August?
meta.author: Codex

items: Each check refers to a separate JSONL evidence log in this folder.
Silver holds validated detail; Bronze preserves source records.
Effective cancellation
A cancellation-at-period-end interval whose paid access spell actually ended.
Cancellation request
An earlier notice to stop renewal; access may continue until the paid period ends.

blocks.text: 113 subscription cancellations took effect in August 2026, representing 113 distinct users and 113 subscriptions (checks 4, 7 and 9).

items: Count ends from 1 August 00:00 UTC inclusive to 1 September 00:00 UTC exclusive.
The separate Gold count of cancellation requests in August is 92; it measures requests, not effective access loss (check 5).
Ad hoc effective-cancellation definition: Silver rows with status cancel_at_period_end, ends_access_spell = 1, and effective_end_at in the window. This is not a separately versioned registry metric.
Silver is used because Gold has requests and snapshot-based churn, not this event count. Source Bronze history independently agrees (check 9).
Snapshot is the metadata users_snapshot_at, 30 September 2026 23:59:59 UTC; this is an as-of assertion, not a verified whole-file hash.
Build succeeded on 9 November 2026; the source access table uses build 3a0dbed21d2f45958aefa2887a0cadd8 (checks 3 and 8).
All 113 qualifying rows have a request timestamp, user and subscription ID, no Silver exception, and matching source values (checks 7 and 10).
The build records successful source-to-Silver and access-loss reconciliations; it does not prove completeness of every historical event (check 3).

The current registry file SHA-256 differs from the hash recorded at build time. The builder hash matches. Consequently, build-time registry identity cannot be verified against the current file; the answer is a transparent ad hoc count based on recorded access fields, not a claim of registry-version identity.
August was interpreted as August 2026, in UTC, consistent with the fixture coverage.

Recorded history may omit or overwrite events; no test proves full source ingestion. This count does not include refunds or other access losses unless represented as a cancellation-at-period-end spell ending in the period.
No causal explanation or period comparison was requested or inferred.
Checks 1–3: schema, dataset metadata, build status and reconciliation.
Checks 4–5: effective ends and Gold request context.
Checks 6–8: source schema, qualifying-row quality and Silver build identity.
Checks 9–10: independent Bronze recount and row-level lineage.
Full SQL, results, truncation flags and timings are in q01–q10 JSONL. See evidence-index.md for corrected layer and snapshot annotations.
